package.name: g1_isaac
package.description: Unitree G1 humanoid -- Isaac Sim adapter. Thin relay layer that maps the Isaac Sim DDS host topics (/livox/lidar, /livox/imu_raw on ROS_DOMAIN_ID 42, sim time via /clock) onto the canonical anubi sensor contract (/lidar/points, /lidar/imu per docs/topic_map.md) and publishes the static TFs the Isaac bringup needs (no URDF/robot_state_publisher runs here). Pending host support for the pelvis IMU (/imu/data) and ground-truth odometry (/odom_raw) is pre-wired behind launch args that default off.
